title: Hearing on NYC Care and health access for uninsured residents
summary: The Council's Hospitals Committee will examine Health + Hospitals' NYC Care program, which provides low-cost and no-cost care to uninsured New Yorkers regardless of immigration status. The hearing comes as federal cuts under the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" have caused roughly 197,000 New Yorkers to lose health coverage and new Medicaid work requirements take effect in January 2027. NYC Care enrollment fell 12%, from about 140,000 patients in fiscal year 2025 to about 123,000 in fiscal year 2026.
